spans.s:
f. (-ला)
The flapping of an elephant's ears, of loose breasts, &c. the word is considered as merely imitative of the noise made.

f. (-री)
1 A sort of drum.
2 A curl.
E.
झल imitative sound, र from रा to get or make, affix ड and ङीप्; also झल्लरी and झल्ली.

f. (-री)
1 A sort of drum.
2 A curl, a lock of hair: see झलरी.
3 A ball, &c. of perfumed substances used for cleaning the hair.
4

f. (-री)
A kind of drum or tabor.
E.
झलरी the same, अण् pleonastic, aff.

f. (-ला)
1 A daughter.
2 Sunshine, splendour, brilliant or glistering light.
3 A cricket; also झाला.

m. (-ल्लः)
A prize fighter, a cudgel player, a man of a tribe following such a profession; one of the degraded classes, being sprung from the outcaste Kṣatriya.
E.
जल to surround or embrace, ल added, and ज changed to झ.

f. (-ल्ली)
A kind of drum: see झलरी.

f. (-लिः)
A sort of sour or unripe mangoes, fried with salt, mustard and asafœtida.

n. (-कं)
Cymbals.
E.
झल्ल imitative sound, a clash, and क what emits, from कै to sound, affix ड.

m. (-ण्ठः)
A pigeon.
E.
झल्ल imitative sound, and कण्ठ a throat.

f. (-का)
1 Light, splendour, lustre.
2 A rag or cloth used for applying colour or perfumes.
3 Dirt brought off the body by rubbing it with perfumes.

m. (-लः)
A ball or protuberance at the lower end of a spindle.
